  /* 1. Only the main title (h1) in purple */

  h4.author, h4.date, .subtitle { color: #333333; font-weight: normal; }

  h2, h3 { color: #2c3e50; font-weight: bold; }

  .list-group-item.active,

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(NanoQuRe)
library(dplyr)

```




## Sequencing Statistics Table
```{r, echo=FALSE}
DT::datatable(sequencing_stats(params$data), caption = 'Table 1: Sequencing Summary Statistics')
```




## Quality Statistics Table
```{r, echo=FALSE}
DT::datatable(quality_stats(params$data), caption = 'Table 2: Sequencing Summary Quality Statistics')
```




## Read Lengths
`r NanoQuRe:::caption_description("read_lengths")`

*`r NanoQuRe:::caption_numbers("read_lengths", params$data, params$platform)`*
```{r, echo=FALSE}
plot_read_lengths(params$data)
```




## Cumulative Yield
`r NanoQuRe:::caption_description("cumulative_yield")`

*`r NanoQuRe:::caption_numbers("cumulative_yield", params$data, params$platform)`*
```{r, echo=FALSE}
plot_cumulative_yield(params$data)
```




## Quality Distribution
`r NanoQuRe:::caption_description("quality")`

*`r NanoQuRe:::caption_numbers("quality", params$data, params$platform)`*
```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE}
plot_quality_distribution(params$data)
```




## Translocation Speed
`r NanoQuRe:::caption_description("speed")`

*`r NanoQuRe:::caption_numbers("speed", params$data, params$platform)`*
```{r, echo=FALSE}
plot_average_speed(params$data)
```




## Sequencing Throughput
`r NanoQuRe:::caption_description("throughput")`

*`r NanoQuRe:::caption_numbers("throughput", params$data, params$platform)`*
```{r, echo=FALSE}
plot_seq_throughput(params$data)
```




## Channel Activity
`r NanoQuRe:::caption_description("channels")`

*`r NanoQuRe:::caption_numbers("channels", params$data, params$platform)`*
```{r, echo=FALSE}

```




## Length and Qscore
`r NanoQuRe:::caption_description("length_qscore")`

*`r NanoQuRe:::caption_numbers("length_qscore", params$data, params$platform)`*
```{r, echo=FALSE}
double_results <- plot_double(params$data)
double_results$length_plot
double_results$qscore_plot
```

## Pore activity heatmap
`r NanoQuRe:::caption_description("heatmap")`

*`r NanoQuRe:::caption_numbers("heatmap", params$data, params$platform)`*
```{r, echo=FALSE}
pore_activity_heatmap(params$data, platform = params$platform)
```
